thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're lining up a joint marketplace listing + HSM partner announcement targeted for June 14. Need confirmation on SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS key flow. Who can own the integration checklist?

sam: I can own SSO/SAML testing. Need IdP metadata, ACS/Entity IDs from partner. @nora can you confirm marketing dates?

nora: tentative yes. We need a short partner one-pager and joint blog outline. Marking June 14 as target. Who's drafting the security blurb?

sam: I'll draft security blurb. For SAML testing, ask partner to provide test IdP and a dev tenant in marketplace. Also we'll require SCIM schema mapping (email, displayName, groups) and SCIM bearer token rotation policy.

jake: On KMS/HSM side: partner supports PKCS#11 and gRPC HSM agent. We need to validate BYOK flow, wrapping key boundary, and audit log shipping. Can someone confirm whether Private deployments will support their agent by EOD?

maria: @jake can you run a short playbook for BYOK validation? Outline: 1) import test wrap key 2) generate ephemeral key 3) sign token to verify. Put steps in repo.

jake: Yup, I'll create a minimal test harness and add CI steps. planning to use this script on staging:
```
# sample: import wrap key
hsmctl import --wrap-key wrap.pem --label partner-wrap
# generate attestation
hsmctl sign --key partner-wrap --in /tmp/payload --out /tmp/sig
```

kevin: Legal: add partner's DPA clause for key custody and SLAs. Also need to confirm export controls for HSMs shipped to EMEA. I'll loop in contracts.

maria: Action items: sam = SAML + SCIM checklist, jake = BYOK test harness + CI, nora = marketing assets + joint blog draft, kevin = legal DPA/controls. I'll setup an announcement runbook and schedule a dry-run (deployment + press) the week prior.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create release window for 'partner-marketplace-announce' on 1799995000. Locking foo until approved.

maria: Thanks team. Meeting to sync tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: checklist status, CI results, marketing assets, press embargo timeline. Ping me if blockers.
